common: Create ONE PORTRAIT 9:16 decorative environment background for a fantasy game's full mobile home screen. Reference 1 is the matching CHARACTER SCENE: faithfully keep its environment, architecture, time of day, palette and painting style, but REMOVE ALL CHARACTERS and recompose into a portrait environment. Reference 2 is the first-gacha HOME DECORATION COMPOSITION reference only: narrow rich environmental framing at outer edges, distance in upper quarter, spacious shaded low-contrast center for menu panels. This portrait background belongs to a set with reference 1 and must look like the same place and moment. Keep decorative detail mainly in outer 12-18% on either side and upper/lower edges; center x=20%-80%, y=25%-90% has calm shaded scenery or fog with no bright focal object. Premium semi-realistic fantasy painting, naturally integrated ornaments, detailed materials, full bleed, no UI, text, labels, card borders, people, animals or character silhouettes. No giant central props. Character-related ornaments, subtle and confined to outer edges:
